ai_summary: Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited (ACGL) has appointed Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP as its new Statutory Auditors, filling a casual vacancy created by the resignation of their previous auditors, B S R & Co. LLP. While the transition to a new major auditing firm marks a significant shift in financial oversight, the undisclosed reasons behind B S R & Co. LLP's departure warrant further scrutiny as a potential red flag.
